description: Prior three-board audit reports 0 missing ID, team, position or stat-value cells; other metric tables were not checked.
impact_on_usability: Unknown row-level missingness for optional metrics.
recommended_mitigation: Validate null rates per metric and season during a bounded pilot; do not impute now.

description: Prior audit reports 0 duplicate player-ID rows within the 18 sampled leaderboard tables; retained raw samples contain only five rows per table.
impact_on_usability: Duplicates outside these tables remain untested.
recommended_mitigation: Check (season ID, stat, player ID, team ID) keys when collecting full metric tables.

description: A sampled goalkeeper profile mixes numeric strings with a ratio-like saved_penalties value (1/3); blanket numeric conversion would fail.
impact_on_usability: Generic numeric casting can corrupt or drop valid fields.
recommended_mitigation: Parse each localizedTitleId by its statFormat and expected shape; retain raw strings.

description: The saves catalog says 'Saves per 90' and a follow-up response labels substatTitle 'Total saves'; the 2019/20 top row has statValue=4 and substatValue=81.
impact_on_usability: Confusing per-90 and totals would create wrong player-season values.
recommended_mitigation: Store value, substat, format and catalog title separately; validate unit semantics before normalization.

description: Among 90 retained first-five goals/minutes/saves rows, 0 main values were nonnumeric, nonfinite or negative. This is a narrow sanity check only.
impact_on_usability: Unseen rows and signed metrics remain unassessed.
recommended_mitigation: Apply metric-specific domains to complete tables in a pilot; do not treat negative goals-prevented values as automatically invalid.

description: All six sampled season catalogs contain 37 identical name/title/category entries; sampled 2019/20 outfield and keeper top cards differ (6 field keys in symmetric difference). Provider computation stability is unverified.
impact_on_usability: Position-specific missingness must not be mistaken for historical drift.
recommended_mitigation: Version schemas by season and position, and compare definitions rather than labels alone.

description: All 12 sampled profile IDs match the selected leaderboard player IDs; this does not validate the full population or external identity matching.
impact_on_usability: IDs appear usable as internal FotMob keys for a pilot.
recommended_mitigation: Keep FotMob IDs as source keys; validate every later join and record transfers separately.

description: The three-board audit reports 0 IDs with multiple team IDs across its sampled boards, but the full season roster and transfer history were not checked.
impact_on_usability: One player-season may need multiple team stints; a single current team can misattribute statistics.
recommended_mitigation: Preserve player-team-season keys and confirm transfer cases in a bounded roster pilot.

description: Sampled leaderboard unions range from 515 to 570 player IDs, but no complete historical player denominator was established.
impact_on_usability: Coverage percentage and omission bias cannot be stated.
recommended_mitigation: Obtain a season-specific roster/reference population before full extraction.

description: Current primary team differs from historical leaderboard team in 9/12 sampled player-seasons; current primary position is also mutable.
impact_on_usability: Historical team/position attribution can be wrong and can leak later information.
recommended_mitigation: Use season-scoped team IDs; label current profile fields explicitly and avoid historical backfill from them.

description: Prior match-index report records dates for 2281/2281 fixture entries; only three raw fixture items per season were retained for independent inspection.
impact_on_usability: Full-date completeness and timezone consistency remain unproven.
recommended_mitigation: Validate UTC parsing, season windows and duplicated scheduled/replayed fixtures during collection.

description: Top-scorer goals agree between leaderboard and sampled season profile in 6/6 seasons; save totals and per-90 values are distinct fields and cannot be compared directly.
impact_on_usability: Other metric definitions and totals have not been reconciled.
recommended_mitigation: Cross-check a stratified set of player-season metrics with units and source titles attached.

description: The 2019/20 Jamie Vardy profile sample carries current initialMatchesPage dates 2026-10-31T15:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-16T19:00:00.000Z alongside a historical statSeasons entry.
impact_on_usability: Using unscoped current match history for 2019/20 would attach future records.
recommended_mitigation: Require explicit season and match-date filters; never treat initialMatchesPage as a historical season index.

description: The 381-entry 2023/24 index contains 380 ordered team pairs; Bournemouth–Luton has two IDs, including abandoned match 4193691 and completed replay.
impact_on_usability: A naive 380-match assumption or unfiltered aggregation can double count a pairing.
recommended_mitigation: Preserve both raw IDs; use cancellation/reason/status to select the completed league fixture for derived views.

description: The bounded retest returned HTTP 400 with error 'Invalid or missing query parameters'. Historical player-to-match pagination remains unverified.
impact_on_usability: A direct complete player-match index cannot yet be planned from this route.
recommended_mitigation: Investigate supported parameters or a sanctioned alternative in a bounded pilot; use fixture lineups selectively.

description: Only the first five leaderboard rows and first three fixtures per season were retained. Count and ID aggregates cross-check internally but cannot be fully recomputed from saved raw subsets.
impact_on_usability: Independent audit reproducibility for full leaderboard identity and date checks is limited.
recommended_mitigation: For a later pilot, retain complete bounded responses or integrity hashes and aggregate extraction manifests.
